title: fagara scandens
intro: Fagara scandens, commonly known as Chinese prickly ash or Szechuan pepper, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Fagara scandens are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, volatile oils, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
